evalCriteria.metric: No network or I/O in the upgrade path
evalCriteria.prompt: Inspect the upgrade handler and anything it calls in the diff. Score 0 if it calls `fetch`, `XMLHttpRequest`, axios or any HTTP client, writes `localStorage`/`sessionStorage`/cookies, or triggers navigation or a page reload.

evalCriteria.metric: Upgrade state is local to the Billing component and preserves renew_at
evalCriteria.prompt: Score 0 if the diff introduces a new React context, global store or module-level mutable state for plan data, or replaces `data` without carrying over the previous `renew_at` value.
evalCriteria.source: spec/plans/requirements.md (REQ-F-03, REQ-F-04); Atlas story doc 7342 Step 3

evalCriteria.prompt: Score 0 if, after the change, `Billing.jsx` still renders a hardcoded "Standard" or "Premium" literal as the badge text or inside the "What's included with" heading, instead of `data.plan_name`.

evalCriteria.metric: Premium values defined once as a module-level constant
evalCriteria.prompt: Score 0 if any Premium value ("$40/month", "4K Ultra HD", "Dolby Vision (select titles)") is declared inside the component body, or duplicated in more than one place in production code.
Score 0 if the diff modifies any file under `src/backend/`.

Score 0 if test files are added under `src/`, if any new package is added to `dependencies` (not `devDependencies`), or if a newly added devDependency uses a range specifier (`^`, `~`, `*`, `latest`) rather than an exact version.
